_: The guided tutorial, as «Abandonar el tutorial» (idt from the client) ends it.
The client's own confirmation says what leaving does: «Estás a punto de saltarte la fase de
aprendizaje sin posibilidad de volver a ella... Conseguirás inmediatamente el set del
intrépido.» Dofus pour les noobs adds that every quest of the tutorial is then validated in
the journal, done or not. Where the character goes is not in any capture; the tutorial's own
end is used: the Dofusarium, cell 127, where Ganymed hands over 1631.
